properties.evidence: One standing makes the other unanswerable in its own terms. 'Which embedded engine compiles fastest' presumes an embedded engine is needed; if the measured answer here is that a store buys only durability and crash-safety, the redb-vs-rocksdb comparison is being run on the wrong axis. Blocks rather than obsoletes: the engine question becomes live again the moment this one settles in favour of keeping a store.
